products.name: YCSU Platform
products.description: Registry-driven central directory and entry point for the YCSU product ecosystem.

products.name: AI Development Control Center
products.description: Spatial AI development orchestration control center for managing AI-assisted development missions and agents.
products.statusNote: M1 Foundation complete locally (functional prototype); runs local-only, not yet deployed. adcc.ycsu.cc does not resolve.

products.name: Fire Pump Test Pit Simulator
products.description: Interactive web-based engineering simulator for exploring fire pump test pit geometry, flow, residence time, suction conditions, and design scenarios.
products.statusNote: Current web tool is functionally complete for the present scope and includes the intended simulation/calculation/visualization toolset. Reopen development only if a new required capability is identified.

products.name: Plumbing Calculation Chart
products.description: Browser-based plumbing fixture calculation tool with occupancy extraction, CPC-based fixture calculations, editable fixture requirements, and Fresno-style Excel output.
products.statusNote: Web V1 production baseline is complete and live at the canonical YCSU Tools route. Existing production validation passed browser calculation/multi-file tests and deterministic backend tests.

products.name: Rachel's Animal Kingdom
products.description: Animal Chess (RaAnimalChess) — a Forest & Desert tactical board game currently in web playtest ahead of App Store v2.0.
products.statusNote: v1.0.7 Web Playtest is live at game.ycsu.cc/RaAnimalChess. Board Node Map v1.4.1 has 77 nodes and 157 valid connections after removing 3 invalid movement edges. Current work focuses on gameplay polish and playtesting; App Store target is v2.0.

products.name: Workflow Hub
products.description: Single-entry architecture workflow/tool library for discovering and launching workflows.
products.statusNote: Phase 1 production release completed and verified on 2026-09-03: Google Sign-In, Guest/Member/Admin access control, access request approval/reject/revoke lifecycle, RLS-protected Launch URLs, Account/Admin frosted-glass overlay, and basic analytics are live. Production OAuth returns to hub.ycsu.cc. Next major milestone: Phase 2 Bubble CMS for Admin create/edit/publish/archive workflows.

products.name: YCSU Tracker
products.description: Tool development tracker — table and kanban views over YSU's tool ideas, priorities, and progress.
products.statusNote: Supabase-backed Tracker is live at tracker.ycsu.cc with cloud data as source of truth, public read access, and owner-authenticated editing. Tracker content refreshed on 2026-09-03 to reflect recent YCSU project progress.

products.name: YSU Mind Map
products.description: Contextual second-brain system that turns AI conversation history and project knowledge into searchable, connected nodes with traceable source context.
products.statusNote: Initial YSU Mind Map web deployment is live at mind.ycsu.cc. Current work remains focused on contextual retrieval, knowledge-graph organization, source traceability, and incremental conversation synchronization.
